title: 荷鲁斯与塞特争夺王位
summary: 奥西里斯死后，荷鲁斯与塞特长期争夺统治权。伊西斯用伪装迫使塞特承认儿子的继承资格，竞赛却仍不断继续，直到神庭裁定荷鲁斯继位，为塞特另作安排。
paragraphs: 《荷鲁斯与塞特之争》的纸草叙事中，奥西里斯死后，儿子荷鲁斯要求继承王位，叔父塞特却以自己的力量与护卫太阳神的功劳争取统治。神庭迟迟不能取得一致，争执延续八十年。伊西斯支持儿子，太阳神却屡次偏向塞特，使本来关于继承的案件变成漫长的审理与较量。
一次神庭移到岛上，塞特要求禁止伊西斯入内。她用金子说动摆渡者，变装成女子登岛，又向塞特诉说一个虚构案件：丈夫死后，陌生人要夺走儿子的牛群。塞特愤怒地判定，不该在儿子尚在时把财产给外人；伊西斯随即显露身份，让他的判断反过来支持荷鲁斯的要求。
争论并未当场结束，双方还比造石船；荷鲁斯以木船覆灰伪装，塞特的真石船却沉了。后来神庭向冥界的奥西里斯征询意见，终于承认荷鲁斯继位，塞特则被太阳神接纳，与天上的雷声相连。这是特定纸草本的诙谐曲折叙述，并非所有埃及材料都按同样顺序安排继承之争。

en.title: Horus and Seth Contest the Throne
en.summary: After Osiris’s death, Horus and Seth dispute the throne before a divided divine court. Isis disguises herself to expose a contradiction in Seth’s claim. Further contests prolong the quarrel before Horus receives kingship and Seth gains a different divine place.
paragraphs: In the papyrus narrative called The Contendings of Horus and Seth, Osiris’s son claims his father’s kingship, while Seth argues from strength and his service defending the solar god. The court cannot agree, and the dispute lasts eighty years. Isis supports her son, but the sun god repeatedly favors Seth, turning the question of succession into a prolonged series of hearings.

When proceedings move to an island from which Isis is excluded, she bribes the ferryman with gold and arrives disguised as a woman. She tells Seth that a stranger threatens to take her dead husband’s cattle from their son. Seth condemns the seizure. Isis reveals herself: his answer supports a son’s inheritance, contradicting the argument he has advanced against Horus.

More contests follow, including a race in stone boats. Horus disguises wood beneath a coating, while Seth’s real stone boat sinks. After the court consults Osiris below, Horus finally receives the throne. Seth is accepted by the solar god and associated with thunder. This particular papyrus preserves a winding, sometimes comic dispute, not a sequence shared identically by all Egyptian sources.

title: 伊西斯与拉的秘密名字
summary: 伊西斯渴望知道太阳神隐藏的名字，取拉的唾液和泥土造出毒蛇，令他在巡行途中受伤。众神无法解毒，拉最终交出秘密，她才以咒语解除毒患，神话也成为治蛇伤的依据。
paragraphs: 在保存这则故事的埃及治蛇伤咒文中，伊西斯希望获得太阳神拉未向其他神明透露的名字。年老的拉行走时唾液落地，她便取来唾液，揉进泥土，塑成一条毒蛇，放在他每日经过的路上。这条蛇出自他的身体，却不是他亲自创造的生灵，因此成为他未曾防备的危险。
拉经过时被蛇咬中，毒液蔓延全身，痛得发抖，召来众神也不能解除。伊西斯上前声称能够治愈，但必须知道他的名字才能施咒。拉先列举创造天地的功业与人们熟知的称号，仍不肯说出隐藏的那个名字；她指出这些并非所求，毒势便继续逼迫受伤的太阳神作出选择。
拉终于同意让秘密的名字从自己传到伊西斯那里，叙事没有把它直接写给读者。获得所需知识以后，她命令毒液离开，宣告拉继续生存、毒害消退。咒文随后把这场神明获救的先例用于现实中的蛇伤患者；故事讲的是隐秘知识与有效言语，不是伊西斯把太阳神永久杀死或废黜。

en.title: Isis and the Secret Name of Ra
en.summary: Seeking Ra’s hidden name, Isis shapes a serpent from his saliva and earth. Its bite defeats ordinary divine help. She offers healing in exchange for the secret, and the resulting cure becomes a mythical precedent invoked for people suffering snakebite.
paragraphs: In an Egyptian healing text, Isis desires the name that the sun god Ra has concealed from other divinities. As the aging god passes, saliva falls from his mouth. She combines it with earth, shapes a serpent, and places it along his regular path. Made from his own substance but not fashioned by him, it presents a danger he has not anticipated.

The serpent bites Ra, and poison spreads through his body. He trembles in pain and summons the gods, but their presence brings no cure. Isis says that she can heal him if he reveals his name. Ra lists his creative achievements and familiar titles instead. She rejects these as insufficient, while the poison forces him to reconsider withholding the concealed name.

Ra finally agrees that the secret name should pass from him to Isis. The narrative does not disclose it directly to its readers. Possessing the required knowledge, she commands the poison to leave and declares that Ra will live. The spell applies this divine rescue to a human snakebite victim: effective hidden knowledge restores the god rather than permanently overthrowing him.
